items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: tailwind-merge-backed className combinator, the one place a conditional Tailwind class list gets built.

items.name: surface-style
items.title: Surface Style
items.description: Zodiac's own 'Gradient to Contrast' background-token ladder (PAGE_BG/WELL_BG/SURFACE_BG). Ported as-is for now (deliberately not yet generalized/theme-injected -- see this repo's own task 04bd1d82) -- a consumer outside Zodiac should replace these three constants with its own tokens before using dialog-chrome.

items.name: dialog-chrome
items.title: Dialog Chrome
items.description: Overlay+content chrome for a Radix Dialog/AlertDialog, extracted from 7 byte-identical duplicated dialog shells across apps/web. width/topOffsetVh are closed literal unions on purpose -- Tailwind's JIT scanner needs static literal class strings, not runtime template literals.

items.name: picker
items.title: Picker
items.description: Generic keyboard-navigable 'search + pick one of several' list. Owns no filtering (caller supplies pre-filtered items) -- built on cmdk (shouldFilter=false) rather than hand-rolled highlight/keyboard-nav state.
